definitions.explanation: A round, crisp fruit with grainy flesh, widely grown and eaten in Japan. When used without qualification, refers to the Japanese pear (nashi pear), which is round and crisp unlike the Western pear.

examples.japanese: {千葉県|ちばけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{梨|なし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: Chiba Prefecture is famous as a pear-growing region.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}てた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧{梨|なし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{甘|あま}くて→甘い：00617_amai⟧⟦{瑞々|みずみず}しい→瑞々しい：06672_mizumizushii⟧。
examples.english: The pears my grandmother grew in the garden are very sweet and juicy.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japan, {梨|なし} refers to the Japanese pear ({和梨|わなし}), which is round, crisp, and grainy — quite different from the Western pear ({洋梨|ようなし}), which is soft and bell-shaped. Major varieties include {幸水|こうすい} and {豊水|ほうすい}. The season is late summer to autumn.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {梨|なし}{狩|が}り: pear picking
- {梨|なし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧: pear-growing region
- {和梨|わなし}: Japanese pear
- {洋梨|ようなし}: Western pear

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
Not to be confused with ⟦{無|な}し→無し：03779_nashi⟧ (none, without), which has the same reading but completely different meaning and kanji.
